scope: source delivery only; no hosted activation, no autonomous action, no natural-event acceptance claim

implemented.resolver: services/evolution/approved_baselines.py resolve_member_baseline reads the schema the existing gate/promotion path persists: registry entry approved state, checksum, owner_tenant, lineage.source_run_ids, evaluation_summary (create_promotion_request: out_of_sample_sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, deflated_sharpe_threshold, backtest_run_id) and embedded metadata.strategy_artifact whose recomputed checksum must equal the entry/member checksum; validated universe = embedded artifact parameters.symbols must equal the member's underlyings; bar_frequency must be daily (gate annualisation sqrt(252))
implemented.return_basis: underlying_net_taiwan_fill_costs, 252 periods: the gate's OOS Sharpe/drawdown are daily, after Taiwan fill costs. member_virtual_book.py adds a net_of_costs metric block on that basis (gross headline unchanged); compare_member_book compares only the block whose basis and annualisation match the baseline, else incomparable_return_basis
implemented.runtime_entry_point: paper_runtime.py _member_book_snapshot (snapshot, heartbeat, signal_generation metadata) now defaults to approved_baselines.http_registry_entry_reader (registry owner endpoint and PERSONA_REGISTRY_* env already used by the pool store, no new setting) with actual tenant/persona/member identity; read failures become explicit registry_entry_missing
implemented.pool_entry_point: persona_strategy_pool.py PersonaStrategyPoolStore.member_baselines (read-only, keyed by pool_version, artifact_ref, checksum)

tests: Recorded Taiwan backtest fixtures (recorded_backtest_tw_2330 / _2330_2317) -> real ReplicationGate -> create_promotion_request -> registry-shaped entry -> runtime snapshot with two members with different baselines; decaying member flagged while a combined series looks healthy; negative cases for unapproved, wrong tenant/checksum/universe/child, missing run/lineage/metrics, failed gate, incomparable basis

validation.command: /tmp/persona-portfolio-venv/bin/python -m pytest test_persona_strategy_pool, test_approved_baselines, test_member_virtual_book, test_portfolio_envelope_parity, test_paper_runtime, test_runtime_summary_projection, test_performance_telemetry

remaining_gaps: The registry entry does not persist the gate's replication_proof or an explicit return_basis/periods_per_year field; the basis is derived from the fixed backtest protocol (daily, sqrt(252), Taiwan fill costs) and the embedded artifact's bar_frequency. An owner-side field would be stronger.
net_of_costs approximates the gate's share-based fill-cost model as exposure-fraction commission and sell tax; it is not identical to vectorbt fills.

The runtime reads the registry owner per member per snapshot with no cache (no cache allowed by scope); hosted runtimes need PERSONA_REGISTRY_BASE_URL/service token wiring by the owner, not verified here.
Tests use recorded fixtures, no hosted market-day claim. Autonomous member actions remain with EVOLUTION-POOL-MEMBER-ACTIONS and POOL-ADMISSION-AND-WEIGHTS.
